chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Predikador gu mar gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Predikador; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juraa'n gu chio'ñ bɨx tu jiim bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu tas.
Jano' ba' gu Generakioon tu' gu ñi'ook jupaabkamu'n; gu' gu oidha' bɨɨx tas pataasa'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas bɨɨx gu ñi'ook pai' maaxilhia'.
Jano' ba' gu jɨvɨl gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan saagi'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx tas gu jɨvɨl jix vɨɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu gɨ' suudai' cham; gio ba' pai' tɨɨtɨs na ba' jix vɨɨk.
Jano' ba' bɨx tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim gu chio'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu vupui ñɨi'ñ tu' maatɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr cham tu' cham tu'x jai'ch jix vɨɨk bɨtaa'n gu tas.
Jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' jix vɨɨk tu' ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch chɨ'ñchoka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' chɨ'ñchoka' ka't mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Predikador jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx matda' bhaan bɨx duñia' bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' dhi' tu jiim jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx buimɨi xoi'kam bɨtaa'n gu tas; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham jɨ'xdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham jɨ'xdha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' matda' bhaan bɨx jix bɨɨx duu va'k tu' gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ tu' matda'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu i'ii'ñ jix maati' matda' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam matda' cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu' bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook xoi'kam; gu' dhi' gio ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dhi'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug bɨɨx suudai' u'va gu i'ii'ñ matda' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jum duu xoi'kam gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buimɨi gu vaak gu ux vaas na mi' oi'ñga'n oidha' u'va.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ux vaas na mi' oi'ñga'n gu u'u bɨx gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu suudai' na ba' pai' gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam jix duñia' gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gio jix duñia' gu maa'nkar jix gɨ' kakneer bhaan bɨx jix bɨɨx duu va'k tu' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio jix toja jodai jix uam jodai chumñigam gu gɨ'kora' oidha' gɨ'; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ mamai'chɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jix bɨɨx duu va'k tu' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' dhi' matda'.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui matgɨm gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' gu i'ii'ñ oi'ñdha' na gu' gu i'ii'ñ jix bhai'x bɨx tu jiim; gio ba' ka't baasɨ'n bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx buimɨi gu ñi'ook gu noobh tu jiim na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham cham tu'x jai'ch bɨtaa'n gu tas.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ba' matda' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ cham tu'x jai'ch gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix duu.
Jano' ba' buupui matda' daam gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tasi' gu tukgam.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x juraa'n gu vupui mo'o gu' gu ñi'ook jiim gu tukgam; gu' cham gu ñi'ook gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' maa'n.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gio tu'; mi' dhɨr na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jano' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gio dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' tu' jix bhai'x tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨ'ñchoka' na ba' bɨɨx tas; na gu' gu tanoolh tu' bɨx ka't gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gio koi jix bhai'x na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; na gu' gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu tas ka't; na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu jiim ka't gu ñi'ook tu duukam bɨtaa'n gu tas; gio ba' ɨlhdham mi' dhɨr tu'.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx tu jiim tu' bɨtaa'n gu tas matda' dhi' gio gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨx tu jiim ka't bɨtaa'n gu tas matda'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx matda' bɨɨx ka't gu chio'ñ cham pai' dhuuk gio dhi' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' jix gɨ'.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook juraa'n gu chio'ñ bɨx tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨtaa'n gu tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu tanoolh cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tulhiiña'; gio ba' gu tukaa' gu i'ii'ñ cham; mi' dhɨr dhi' gio gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tutkɨ na ba' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ xoi'kam tu jiim; gio ba' gio no'ñ tu' buupui dhi' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' chɨkka jugi chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tutkɨ tu'.
Na gu' na gu' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix maa matda'; gu' ua'tulhdhix jix maa tu jiim na ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gio dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Na ba' na ba' bɨx tu'x cham tu'x jai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr juraa'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook maaxilhia' gu ñi'ook koi; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ux na tu ibai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kooda' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu' duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix xuaak gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai gu ñi'ook gu jodai; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook nukadham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ñiokda'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juraa'n.
Jano' ba' tu' buupui tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oipichu' jix maa gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' cham gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham cham tu'x jai'ch tutkɨ na ba' jix duñia' duñia' xoi'kam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu chio'ñ xoi'kam bɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bɨx gu Jawatan Dios duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bhaan mii' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios na ba' vupui bhaan gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ka't tu'; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨtaa'n gu tas; gio ba' pai' ñi'ook na jir bhai'; mi' dhɨr pai' bɨx bhai' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jir bhai' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨx.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tuutu'm gu vaakax.

Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n; gio ba' na ja'p kuusdaidha'; mi' dhɨr namki' bɨx; jano' ba' tu' juraa'n gu chio'ñ gu vaakax; na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx tu' pai'; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook oo' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ jiix gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n bɨtaa'n gu oidha'.
Na ba' buupui cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tutkɨ jix duñia' gu chio'ñ bɨɨx jix duñia'; na gu' dhi' baasɨ'n; na gu' chɨkka na ba' tu' mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu Torneeme tu' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam bɨtaa'n gu tas; gio ba' suakɨt cham mambhɨɨx; mi' dhɨr gu kavɨk ka't gu novɨ na ba' cham ka't nuukdaidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix koko' na jix do'ig bɨɨx ka'm jano' ko'iix.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tutkɨ cham tu' jix duñia' cham tu' buupui buimɨi bɨtaa'n gu tas xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' buupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu jiim bɨx gu ñi'ook buimɨi oidha' bhaan jiim jɨɨgak gu chio'ñ bhaan tɨtmo; gio ba' gio dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh jugi gu chuukug.
Gu' gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bhuup bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tu jiim gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu tas.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; na tu' juraa'n gu mar tu' xibhɨk; gu' cham pai' dhuuk tu' gu vupui namkɨm tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' na ba' chɨkka tu jiim tu' gu i'ii'ñ xoi'kam gio dhi' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x tu jiim.
Jano' ba' tutkɨ gook maa'n; na gu' namki' tutkɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n jix búup duiñchu'; na pai' dhuuk gu' gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk cham gook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gio tu' gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtda:―Aañ; gu' gu ñi'ook maa'n.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan maa'n gook no'm bhaan; gio ba' vaik cham jootom.
Jano' ba' tutkɨ gu ñi'ook gampai' jix bhai'x gu gɨ'kora' jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham.
Na gu' na gu' kuupa' jix buus na ba' gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maaxir oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix duu gampai'.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨx na jix do'ig bɨtaa'n gu tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook pai'.
Jano' ba' cham juraa'n gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't va'k; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aajim mi' dhɨr no'm bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr dhi' gio gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix nukadham tɨɨt; gio ba' na ba' gu maa'nkar; na gu' cham xoi'kam cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu chin tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr tu' bhaan gu oidha'; na ba' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daaxdhak cham jix duñia'; na gu' cham; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' tutkɨ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin na ba' gu chuukug; gio ba' tu' vupui bhaan nobii'ñ ka't; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu Jawatan Dios kuiñcha gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu noobh.
Na pai' tɨɨtki' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu ñi'ook mumua'da' gu ñi'ook; gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bia' gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai' oidha' gɨ' cham tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim dhi'; na gu' jix bhai'x tɨɨgɨk bhaan jix bhai'x maa'n jix bhai'x bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' na ba' bɨx; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' vaak ja'tkam.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuumiñ cham tuumiñ; gio ba' jix jai' mambhɨɨx cham gu i'bhɨ; mi' dhɨr gio dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio; gio ba' xoi'kam gɨ'kora' vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai'; gu' cham koox.
Jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ko'kdai' buupui bɨtaa'n gu tas; gio ba' namkɨm na ba' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam cham tu' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix buus vook gu naan tɨbiaptuda gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p suudai' u'va; gio ba' cham tu' jix duñia' tu jiim na ba' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gio cham bhai' na ja'p suudai' u'va ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu jɨvɨl.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' jugi gu tukgam bɨɨx jix jai'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam tu' buupui; na jix bhai' jugi i'i maa'n xoi'kam bɨx tu jiim bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu tas bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa; na gu' dhi' baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix maa namkɨm jix maa gio na ba' baasɨ'n tu jiim; gio ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai' gu tanoolh gu oidha'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch cham bhai' buupui bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr gu bhóogɨt kua'dam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix maa namkɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨidhat cham tu' uañi'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ jix duu; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix maa jugi gu ñi'ook kua'da'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu ñi'ook ko'kdai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chamaam mui'x gu tanoolh ua'tulhi'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu i'ii'ñ cham xoi'kam gio tu' tutkɨ.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' suudai' u'va gu tukgam tu' bɨɨx gu tukgam ka't jix bhaan dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't buupui gu tas tu' cham tu' jɨɨpi'ñka' juraa'n.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gook mui'kim tu' cham tu' xoi'kam tɨɨda' bɨx pai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx tu jiim gu chio'ñ na ba' gu chin bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juraa'n jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook juraa'n gampai' jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ ko'iix.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' ñiata gu vupui gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gio dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Na tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ cham bɨɨx jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mumua'da' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook juraa'n gu chio'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam gu chio'ñ gu oidha' bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu ñi'ook na ja'p ɨkgiga'n na gu' chɨkka gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't mi' dhɨr bɨtaa'n gu tas.
Jano' ba' tutkɨ jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jix bhai' choi'; gio ba' gu tanoolh koi'm gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' tutkɨ tu' gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak; na gu' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chichio'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tutkɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' bɨɨx ɨlhdha' gu vupui gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ mamatdagɨm gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tutkɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p jo'ii' bɨtaa'n; gio ba' gio dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tutkɨ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨpɨ'; gio ba' tutkɨ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; na gu' daak baaso gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu ñi'ook kuiñcha jix bɨɨx duu tutkɨ suulhgia' na gu' cham pai' dhuuk dhi' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx matda'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx; gio ba' gu tas.
Na gu' na gu' kutun kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kutun kavɨk tuumiñ; gu' matda' jix maa gu oidha' bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' chɨkka.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam; gio ba' gu tanoolh cham bhai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gio jix duu dhi' vupui bhaan na gu' gu chio'ñ cham gu ñi'ook cham tu' bhaan.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' buupui gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jir bhai' cham tu'x jai'ch jix koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' cham tu'x jai'ch jix bhai'x tu' na cham jir bhai' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bhai' tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' jix jai' tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook koi va'k gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gio dhi' cham gu novɨ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx.
Jano' ba' matda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx kiicham jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ jir bhai' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam cham pai' dhuuk.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ bɨx tu'x tu ñi'ook na gu' cham tu duukam cham bhai' tu'.
Na gu' na gu' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p tu' gio tu ñi'ook cham bhai' mumua'da' mui'kim.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx matda' bham; gio ba' jix duñia'; gu' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix dhaam suudai' chɨkka gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim tu' matda' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix maati' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook maakam.
Jano' ba' tu' gaagam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim koi'm gu u'vɨ a'sak gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu noobh na ja'p; na gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gu' ua'tulhdhix ka't kuupka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gaagam tu ñi'ook gu Predikador tu'x na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ cham; gio ba' gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x gaagam; gu' gu u'vɨ bɨx cham pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gaagam dhi'; na gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu' gu ñi'ook mumua'da'.
Jano' ba' chɨkka na ja'p jix bhai'x chɨkka na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'x matda' gu chio'ñ gu vupui.
Jano' ba' tu' aa'ñdham nukadham gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' bɨx.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx tajaañ chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kuee gu ñi'ook.
Na jix nukadham gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' jix maati' gu i'ii'ñ jix bhai'x.
Na gu' na gu' na ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gu' tu jiim gu chio'ñ jix gɨ' bhaan.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' duuk ka't chɨkka.

Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ jix duñia' tajaañ bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tu' tajaañ bhaan gu tanoolh koi'm; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr tu' bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' buupui gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ bɨx bɨtaa'n gu tas duñia'; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na ba' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu' gio; na jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨtɨs chɨ'ñchoka'; gu' pai' jix bhaan jix bɨɨx duu kiicham pai' bɨɨx; jano' ba' dhi' gio gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ jix bhuup na ba' duñia' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam ua'tulhdhix gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' gu ñi'ook mui'kim ka't sɨlhka'n bɨɨx bɨx tu' gio tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' xoi'kam vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam tu' ka't gu tanoolh na ja'p ɨkgiga'n; na gu' cham vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook duñia' bhaan gu oidha'; na cham tu'x jai'ch jir bhai' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p tu' buimɨi jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch jix bhai'x na ja'p tu' buimɨi jir bhai' ja'tkam; jano' ba' dhi' gio gu ñi'ook.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhai' ñi'ook; na cham juraa'n gu chio'ñ xoi'kam bɨtaa'n gu tas gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr dhi' jix duñia' tu jiim gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa bɨtaa'n gu tas.
Jano' ba' tu' gu i'ii'ñ jix maati' matda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' bhaan gu oidha'; na gu' cham tu'x jai'ch tu' gu tukaa' tu' gu tanoolh tu' gu vupui; mi' dhɨr.

Jano' ba' buupui bɨx buimɨi gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ cham jɨ'xdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu tas duñia'; gio ba' jix jai' gu chio'ñ cham gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix maa gu i'ii'ñ bɨx dhi' tu'x na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi'; na jir bhai' ja'tkam mamatdagɨm buimɨi gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham gu chio'ñ tu' xoi'kam tu' bɨx vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; gio ba' jir bhai' jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr jix bhai' cham; jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' cham gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' na ja'p jix bhai' jix duñia'; na gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' dhi' cham bhai' cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx duñia' bɨtaa'n gu tas bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ jix bhuup cham bhai' gu i'ii'ñ gu oidha'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr koko'kam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch nɨɨra na ba' bɨx tɨjɨɨ'ñ ko'iix; na gu' tutkɨ gagai' gu ñi'ook maavɨt jix koi.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' koi; gu' koko'kam cham tu' tu' namki'; na gu' chɨ'ñchoka' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gio xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨɨgak tu'; gio ba' tu' juraa'n tu' baasɨ'n bɨx duñia' bɨtaa'n gu tas.
Jano' ba' jiim jugi gu takarui' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'i suudai' u'va bɨɨx jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' buimɨi tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook ka't jix toja jajannulhi'ñ cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' choi' bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨtaa'n gu tas bɨx gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook; na gu' dhi' baasɨ'n pai' tu jiim bɨɨx tu' bɨtaa'n gu tas.
Jano' ba' bɨx tu' daraibu' gu novɨ na ba' duñia' tu jiim bhaan gu ñi'ook; na gu' tukga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook tu' matda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨtaa'n gu tas tu' jix bhai'x tu' bhɨɨ'ñdham jix kavɨk tu' mamatdagɨm gu takarui' tu' mamatda' namkɨm tu' gu ñi'ook; gu' gu ñi'ook bua' bɨx.

Na gu' na gu' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maati' gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk na ja'p gu vatop ui'ka' jix vɨgɨ na ja'p gu u'uvhig jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook cham bhai' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x bhaan.
Jano' ba' gio tu' dhi' matda' bɨtaa'n gu tas gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' jupaabkamu'n bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gampai' jix bhai'x kiicham bɨɨx matda'; gio ba' soo'mchulhdhak mii' dhɨr gampai' gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' tutkɨ matda' gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gampai' ka't cham ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x bɨɨx jɨɨpi'ñka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tutkɨ matda' gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham; gu' ua'tulhdhix gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi'm xoi'kam cham bhai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n matda' nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix bhai'x gu novɨ tu jiim; gu' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu novɨ o'nsop.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ta'm na tu maakia' gu Dios bhaan tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai'; na gu' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch cham bhai' bɨtaa'n gu tas buupui maakam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chutumñigam pai'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu duukam kavaayo chiñia' jiim na ja'p tu duukam bhaan gu oidha'.
Na jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' oidha' bhai' gu ko'oi.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai tu jiim; na gu u'u.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk jodai cham ua'tulhi'ñ cham tu'x jai'ch jano' ba' gu kavɨk; gu' cham gu ñi'ook joi'gɨ'nda' matda'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ko'oi na pai' dhuuk cham tutkɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chin jix bhai'x nɨidhidha'; gu' gu ñi'ook kuiñcha gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu chin gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix mui' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ tu'; mi' dhɨr chɨkka maachim mi' dhɨr ka't.
Jano' ba' tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; na gu' cham duukat tu' kiicham.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook tu' gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook chiñia' kua'da' gu xibh.
Na pai' dhuuk gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu' gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu mar gu bhóogɨt chiñia' kua'da' gu tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham i'i.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' gu noobh gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' suudai' u'va jix duñia' ko'iix; gio ba' tuumiñ tu ñi'ook bɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham bhai'; na gu' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook namki' jix duu maachim gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu takarui' bhaan gu suudai'; na mi' dhɨr mui'x gu tanoolh bakia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' kɨɨv gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' cham ñɨidhat cham bhai' ɨlhdham bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' tɨbaa'ñ ua'tulhi'ñ jix bhuup gu suudai' bhaan gu oidha' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu u'u gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam saagi'ñ gu ñi'ook pai' gu u'u.
Na gu jɨvɨl gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tɨbaa'ñ cham.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu' cham ñɨidhat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu jɨvɨl gu ñi'ook o'oo vook gu u'vɨ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios duñia' bɨx tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh chutku' gu kai' gu xumai cham gu ñi'ook gu novɨ; na gu' tu' cham ñɨidhat tutkɨ tu' dhi' tu' gook tu'x jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu tas.
Gu' gu' tu' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mui'x bɨx bhɨɨya' bhai' ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' mi' dhɨr jix duñia' chɨ'ñchoka' gu tanoolh gu tukgam ka't mui'x bɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam biapma' gu i'ii'ñ gu tanoolh; gio ba' jiim gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ ñiata gu vupui; gu' bhaan bɨx dhi' tu'x tu' gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu chuukug; na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Akueerdate gu Kriador gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k tomaat gu tanoolh cham no'ñ.
Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas gu tasi' gu masad gu si'avag tɨbaa'ñ bhaan dhuuk.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook nuuka'n gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' kiki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu u'uvhig bɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gio gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu chio'ñ tu' gu vaak jiim ɨrban.
Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu ñi'ook ka't bhaan oidha' suudai'.
Jano' ba' oo' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' na ja'p ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Predikador bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x ka't gu Predikador gu ñi'ook matda' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' jix duu jix kai tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim mui'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Predikador gu ñi'ook gu'p gu ñi'ook tu'r.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mamatdagɨm na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ja'p gu Pastor.
Jano' ba' jano' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu'; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook duñia' mui'x o'dam ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix jai' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak dhi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix nukadham gu ñi'ook; na gu' dhi' bɨx gu chio'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨx jix bhai'.
